# brig sandbox stop

Stop a sandbox, keeping its /sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox stop [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Stop a sandbox, as openshell sandbox stop does. Every program in it ends,
the agent included; its /sandbox stays for [`brig sandbox start`](brig-sandbox-start.md).

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
